subject.title: [Feature]: Make transient macOS launches relocate safely

question: Should the macOS app own the proposed early relocation and installed-copy handoff UX for launches from DMGs, App Translocation, Downloads, and Desktop?
rationale: Current source proves the hazard, but installed-copy precedence, replacement prompting, and which transient locations trigger intervention are native product-policy choices.

options.title: Adopt bounded relocation
options.body: Add the early coordinator with stable custom paths untouched and explicit identity, version, replacement, and relaunch rules.

options.title: Guard persistence only
options.body: Stop transient bundle paths from reaching launch-at-login while leaving transient Sparkle startup and installed-copy handoff unresolved.

options.title: Document unsupported launch
options.body: Rely on the DMG Applications affordance and document direct transient launches as unsupported.

recommendation.title: Adopt bounded relocation
recommendation.body: Add the early coordinator with stable custom paths untouched and explicit identity, version, replacement, and relaunch rules.

likelyOwner.reason: This person proposed the issue and has recent merged history on the exact macOS startup and AppState surfaces.
